model_annotation: This figure, sourced from Eurostat, presents three donut (ring) pie charts illustrating the distribution of enterprises, employment, and net turnover across four economic sectors—Industry, Construction, Trade, and Other Services—in 2021, expressed as percentages of the total economy with absolute values, classified by NACE Rev. 2. Each chart contains four slices corresponding to the same four categories, identified by a shared legend at the bottom: Industry is shown in gold/yellow, Construction in light blue, Trade in red/coral, and Other Services in dark navy blue. The first chart, labeled "Number of Enterprises," shows Other Services as the dominant category at 61% (19.0 million), followed by Trade at 19% (5.9 million), Construction at 12% (3.7 million), and Industry at 8% (2.4 million). The second chart, labeled "Number of Persons Employed," displays Other Services again as the largest segment at 51% (80.2 million), followed by Industry at 21% (33.0 million), Trade at 19% (29.5 million), and Construction at 9% (13.4 million). The third chart, labeled "Turnover," shows Industry as the largest share at 33% (10.6 trillion), followed by Trade and Other Services both at 31% (9.9 trillion and 9.8 trillion respectively), and Construction at 6% (1.9 trillion). Each slice is labeled directly with both its percentage and absolute value, and the segments within each chart appear arranged clockwise. The visual emphasis across all three charts highlights the shifting dominance of Other Services in enterprise count and employment versus the more balanced distribution in turnover, where Industry takes the largest share.
